g.text: Engineering scalable full-stack applications & autonomous AI.
React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, REST
Autonomous pipelines, VAPI voice agents, LLMs
From rough idea to shipped MVP & Three.js 3D web

text.tspan: Designing multi-agent workflows and programmatic voice
agents (VAPI + Twilio) that converse naturally and execute
complex multi-step tasks in real time.
Engineered dynamic traffic signal control integrating
MATLAB YOLOv4 computer vision, NVIDIA Gemma 3 vision
for ambulances, and ESP8266 IoT hardware.
National Finalist at Smart India Hackathon 2025.
Built SAKSHAM (unified beneficiary portal) and CityFix
civic platform from rough idea to working deployment.
